# Build Plan offer: Larkspur Ceramics

## What you get
You asked for each order to be checked against the stock the warehouse holds before it is confirmed, and for a short order to be flagged to the customer the same day. Stock is kept on a whiteboard today, so this needs a new record of stock. The Build Plan settles how that should work, beside the order flow already being built.

- A written Build Plan: how the work runs today, what should change, the scope, what is out of scope, acceptance checks you can run yourself, risks and what we need from you.
- A fixed quote for the build, as a separate document.
- The plan is yours to keep, whoever builds it.

## How long
1 week from the start date we agree.

## Fee
USD 1,500.00, payable within 14 days of the invoice.

## Credit
If you sign the build within 60 days of receiving the plan, the fee is credited against the build.

## Valid until
This offer is valid until 15 December 2026.

Robin
